description: End-to-end scenarios. Implement each as a Playwright test in tests/e2e/<id>.spec.ts using seed-data.json and mock providers (mock payment completion via /dev/payments, messages via /dev/messages). Use a fixed clock where dates matter. A phase is done when all its scenarios pass on the Vercel preview/staging.

scenarios.title: Tenant isolation
steps: Create a second garage 'Other Garage' with its own owner
Call a server action with Other Garage's vehicle id
expect: Action returns FORBIDDEN or NOT_FOUND; no data leaked

scenarios.title: Onboarding and invite
steps: Complete wizard with one branch and two bays
Open invite link from /dev/messages and accept
expect: Mechanic nav shows only mechanic items

scenarios.title: Check-in to tracker
steps: Enters odometer 110500, fuel 50%, 4 photos, complaint, template 'Diagnostics scan', assigns Yaw, signs
expect: Job created with status checked_in and number JOB-SPX-...
Odometer reading saved and km/day recalculated

scenarios.title: Partial estimate approval
steps: Advisor builds estimate with 3 lines and sends
expect: Board card updates in a second browser within 1s

scenarios.title: Mechanic offline
steps: Tick 3 checklist items, start and stop timer, add a note

scenarios.title: QC gate
steps: Try to move a job from quality_check to ready without sign-off
expect: Ready succeeds, customer gets job_ready message

scenarios.title: Public booking
steps: Choose Oil service, enter vehicle and phone, confirm code

scenarios.title: Odometer validation
steps: Record a reading lower than the last one for GR 1234-24
expect: Reading flagged and excluded from km/day

scenarios.title: Invoice and MoMo payment
steps: Job reaches ready; draft invoice created from approved lines
Customer opens pay link, chooses MTN MoMo
Complete mock payment and deliver webhook twice

scenarios.title: Deposit applied
steps: Estimate for Full service requires 30% deposit
Customer pays deposit on approval page
expect: Deposit shown as allocation; balance reduced accordingly

scenarios.title: Instalment plan
steps: Create plan on a GH₵ 3,000 invoice: GH₵ 600 down, 3 monthly instalments
Advance clock past first due date without paying

scenarios.title: Credit account limit
steps: Charge Swift Logistics job invoice to credit account
Attempt invoice that exceeds GH₵ 20,000 limit as accountant
expect: Owner override succeeds and is audited
Statement generated on statement_day with ageing

scenarios.title: Delivery creates oil reminder
steps: Complete and pay an 'Oil service — mineral' job for GR 1234-24 at 110500 km
expect: oil_change due item created with due_date +3 months and due_mileage 115500

scenarios.title: Gapless numbering
expect: Numbers consecutive with no gaps or duplicates

scenarios.title: Daily and monthly report
steps: Create payments, expenses and parts sales over 3 days

scenarios.title: Stock reserve and issue
steps: Approve estimate with 1 brake pad set
expect: Reserved on approval, issued on delivery, stock_movements recorded

scenarios.title: POS sale and return
steps: Sell 2 wiper blades and 1 coolant for cash

scenarios.title: Marketplace order to stock
steps: Storekeeper orders 24 oil filters from Accra Auto Supplies
Vendor accepts, marks out for delivery, delivered

scenarios.title: Auto-reorder
steps: Enable auto-reorder with spend limit GH₵ 2,000
Sell brake pads until below reorder level
expect: Exactly one order created for Kumasi Parts Hub
Auto-sent only if total <= limit, otherwise awaiting approval notification

scenarios.title: Job-linked order
steps: Approve estimate with a part that is out of stock

scenarios.title: Customer orders to garage
steps: Customer in portal orders a tyre from Kumasi Parts Hub for delivery to Pitstop
Garage receives incoming order and books fitting

scenarios.title: Insurance escalation
expect: Next reminder scheduled for 14 days before

scenarios.title: Combined reminder
steps: Vehicle with insurance and roadworthy both due within the same week

scenarios.title: WhatsApp fallback
expect: Max 2 paid messages for the reminder

scenarios.title: Mileage-based oil reminder
steps: Kofi's ride-hailing car has high km/day
expect: Oil reminder sent before the date-based due date

scenarios.title: Insurance agent renewal end to end
steps: Staff uploads new policy and sticker, completes
expect: New insurance_policy saved with new end date
Old due item completed, new one scheduled

scenarios.title: DVLA roadworthy renewal with pre-inspection
steps: Pre-inspection job finds a faulty brake light and is repaired
Fee from dvla_fees + service fee paid

scenarios.title: Insurance renewal gated
expect: 'Renew with my garage' not offered; 'Already done' still available

scenarios.title: Customer portal isolation
steps: Abena signs in with phone OTP
expect: Can update mileage and pay balances

scenarios.title: Allowance exhausted
expect: OTP and receipts still sent by SMS

scenarios.title: Impersonation audit
steps: Admin impersonates Pitstop owner and edits a customer

scenarios.title: Accessibility and performance
steps: Run axe on dashboard, job board, check-in, tracker, pay page
Run Lighthouse mobile on the same
